title: Backtrace of a raise of the last raised exception continues the earlier one
summary: A raise of the exception value that was raised last, here `Exit`, continues the backtrace of the earlier raise, which was handled: the backtrace starts at `first` and says `Re-raised at Test.second`. OCaml 5.4.0 starts it at `second`.
cause: `stdlib/stdlib.ml`: `raise` is `%reraise`; `runtime/backtrace_nat.c` and `backtrace_byt.c` keep the backtrace when the exception is the one raised last.
